name.zh: 莱克忒亚刑罚与一事不再理习惯

periods.description: Livia explains that after a powerful authority punishes an evil actor, others should not punish the same offender again; regression/deprivation of wisdom/ability can be understood as a punishment just below death.
periods.principles: Punishment right is not duplicated; level/ability reset resembles severe penal deprivation.
limitations: does not automatically satisfy Terra legal systems
